data.one_liner: Builds matched light and dark ThemeData for Flutter with Material design themes and seed colors.
data.what_it_does: FlexColorScheme builds matched light and dark ThemeData for Flutter with support for seed-generated ColorSchemes, surface blends, and component theme settings. It provides custom color palettes and ensures complete color scheme wiring.
use_when: You want robust Material Design themes with advanced seed-generated color schemes.
You need matched light and dark themes with optional surface alpha blends.
You want simplified property configurations for standard Flutter component themes.
avoid_when: You are using a version of Flutter older than 3.47.0.
You do not want to rely on external material and cupertino UI package decoupled requirements.
strengths: Extensive built-in palettes and color options.
Advanced seed color generation options with customizable tone mapping.
Comprehensive component theme defaults following Material 3 guidelines.
weaknesses: Major breaking changes between major versions require manual migration.
data.setup_notes: Add flex_color_scheme to pubspec.yaml and import both flex_color_scheme and material_ui.
